# Local AI Sources

> A public monthly record of which businesses and which source domains AI engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini) cite when asked "Who is the best {vertical} in {city}, Florida?" for 10 service verticals in 10 Central Florida cities. Published by EVOIX LLC, DeLand, Florida. Author Stephane Morera. Data CC BY 4.0.

Latest run: November 2026, collected 2026-11-02. Panel v1, 100 fixed prompts, one answer per prompt per engine per month, every row published.

## Pages
- [Home](https://localaisources.com/): this month's headline figures per engine
- [Method](https://localaisources.com/method/): panel, instrument, what is counted, changelog, noise floor
- [Data](https://localaisources.com/data/): JSON and CSV downloads per month
- [Engines](https://localaisources.com/engines/): per-engine pages
- [Sources](https://localaisources.com/domains/): every cited domain with counts
- [Months](https://localaisources.com/runs/): every monthly run

## Origin
- [Central Florida AI Citation Study](https://evoix.io/research/central-florida-ai-citation-study): the July 2026 study that became month zero
